sources.title: Use Claude's chat search and memory
What are artifacts and how do I use them?

folds.text: A **project** is a workspace for one ongoing effort, like a trip or a thesis. Files and instructions you add are there at the start of every chat inside it.
**Memory** lets Claude keep short notes about you from your chats. You can read, edit or delete them in settings, or switch memory off.
**Instructions for Claude** are account-wide preferences, like "keep answers short". **Project instructions** apply only inside one project.
An **artifact** is something Claude makes for you to keep: a document, a small tool, a page. It opens beside the chat. You can edit it and share it later.
To change how Claude sounds, use **skills**. Claude's help page lists them for adjusting the tone and format of replies, or following your own writing patterns.

folds.prompt: Which feature fits this need? Tap the basket.

items.text: Keep my trip plans and notes together for weeks
items.why: A project holds files and context for one effort.

items.text: Claude should remember I am vegetarian
Make me a printable packing checklist to keep
items.why: Artifacts are things Claude makes for you to keep.

items.text: Reuse the same study guide in many chats
Make Claude's replies shorter and more casual
items.why: Skills adjust the tone and format of replies.
